reader.requirement: At --std 85 every record description of an SD must name the one record area, so after a RETURN each of them (shorter, longer, group or elementary, signed numeric or variable-occurrence) views the returned record's characters as an implicit redefinition; only the positions past the current record's size are undefined.

The INTO phrase's IntoPhraseRules.Return.PhraseAt reads the edition only to pick the citation text of its diagnostics (BoundTree.cs), not behaviour, and belongs to GR5/GR6.

reader.notes: BindReturn resolves the store through PlaceTable.RecordArea, the largest record's view of the one SD record area, and EmitReturn writes the returned image there through SequentialIoEmitter.EmitRecordAreaStore / EmitImageInto, so every 01 under the SD redefines the same characters. The path consults no edition; every probe at --std 85 showed each description viewing the returned record.
